newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed unit gets Postal Service pact.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed unit gets Postal Service pact.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said on Tuesday that it received a $55 million contract from the U.S. Postal Service for a system to process handwritten letters.
The computerized system would automate processing mail that would otherwise have to be manually handled, Lockheed Martin said.

This contract places Lockheed Martin Federal Systems, the subsidiary that received the contract, in a strong position as a supplier and systems integrator in address recognition technology, the company said.

The State University of New York at Buffalo's Center of Excellence for Document Analysis and Recognition developed the original hand written address interpretation software and will serve as a subcontractor by making the software suitable to be integrated into the U.S. Postal Service's equipment.
